How paying works

## One signature, the exact amount, no gas.

- Pick a plan and a length. 30 days, 90 days or a year, priced in USDC.

- Approve the exact amount in your wallet. You sign an authorisation (EIP-3009) for that amount to our receiving address and nothing else. It cannot be reused or raised.

- Coinbase settles it on Base. Their x402 facilitator submits the transfer and pays the gas; your plan starts at once and you get the BaseScan receipt.

Where the money goes

Every payment goes straight to one published address on Base. We never hold your funds or keys, and nothing is pulled later: a plan ends when its period does.

Receiving address see the x402 manifest

Agents buy the same evidence packs per call over x402; the manifest at /.well-known/x402 lists every price.

Questions

You sign a plain text message that names this site, your address, a one-time code and the time (Sign-In with Ethereum). It proves you control the wallet. It creates no transaction, costs no gas and never reveals a key. A signed session stays in this browser for up to 30 days; your wallet address is your account.

Any wallet that can sign a message: MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, Rabby, Trust, Phantom, Brave and others in the browser, or a Base Account, which signs with a passkey and needs no app or extension. On a phone, choose Base Account or open this page inside your wallet app.

Plans are paid in USDC on Base from the wallet you signed in with: your wallet shows the exact amount and the receiving address before you approve, and you pay no gas. Plans are prepaid and never renew by themselves. If the Desk does not work for you, write to us within 14 days of paying and we refund the unused days; the Terms have the details.
